known.title: Claude SDK workers still require a separate claude executable
Not done: missing-SDK refusal before state changes
An SDK result without text or errors crashes Forge's result handling

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. `_run` refuses when `claude` is absent from PATH, even though the pinned SDK [uses its bundled Claude executable](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python/v0.2.161/src/claude_agent_sdk/_internal/transport/subprocess_cli.py). A client with the SDK installed by `forge doctor --fix` but no separate CLI cannot run a Claude worker. The new test always installs a CLI stub, so it misses this case.
findings.title: Claude SDK workers still require a separate claude executable

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 2, Harm 3
Raise: Not done. Design rounds skip `ready()` at worker.py:136, so its new SDK check at line 380 never runs. Forge commits the round's state at line 238 before `_run` checks the SDK here. With `workers = "split"`, a user-facing Claude round therefore changes state and may fall back to Codex when the SDK is missing, instead of refusing before state changes as this part requires. The new missing-SDK test covers only a lite worker.
findings.title: Not done: missing-SDK refusal before state changes

findings.body:
Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 3
Raise: Functional. The pinned SDK [allows `ResultMessage.result` and `errors` to both be `None`](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-python/v0.2.161/src/claude_agent_sdk/types.py). Serializing the whole dataclass includes `"errors": null`; when the result has no text, the unchanged adapter at repo.py:414 expands that value as a list and raises `TypeError`. A no-answer result then produces a traceback instead of Forge's no-turn refusal, and an affected failed resume cannot reach the fresh-session recovery. The stub sets `errors` to an empty list, masking this SDK shape.
findings.title: An SDK result without text or errors crashes Forge's result handling
